test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**planting**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the benefits and solutions associated with tree planting.
 
• The appropriate gerund should indicate an action that can help the environment and biodiversity.
 
• "**Planting**" fits well as it denotes an action that directly contributes to the restoration of forests and combating climate change.
 
• Other options ("**by planting**", "**for planting**", "**with planting**") do not fit the context of describing the action needed for environmental benefits.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Trees provide so many benefits (1)____ our everyday lives. They filter clean air, provide fresh drinking water, help (2)______ climate change and create homes for thousands of species of plants and animals. (3)* *Planting__* *a billion trees can help save the Earth from climate change and biodiversity loss. When we restore and (4)* _______ *critical forests, we remove carbon and support biodiversity. A billion is a big number, but we know we can do it together. (5)* ***___________* *** the planet by planting your tree today. This can protect and restore forests for future.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• By planting: While this phrase indicates the manner of planting, it does not fit the grammatical structure of the passage.
 
• For planting : This phrase indicates purpose but does not fit in the sentence structure given in the passage.
 
• With planting: Indicates association but is not suitable in the given context of discussing the benefits of tree planting.
